title: A <video> element inside a canvas
blurb: A playing video with its native controls and captions, drawn through a fragment shader. The controls still work. Cross-origin and encrypted video are left out of the picture.
question: Does a playing <video> with native controls and captions draw into a canvas, frame by frame, and do its controls still work under a shader?
result: Frames, controls and ::cue captions are drawn, and paint fires for each video frame. Cross-origin video without CORS and encrypted video are left out.
